verdict.rationale: Deliverability monitoring is a fair question for an email marketing platform like Klaviyo, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only generic reporting, analytics pulls and performance reports. It never mentions bounce, complaint or blocklist signals per send, or guidance when deliverability degrades.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can see bounce, complaint, and blocklist signals per send and get actionable guidance when deliverability degrades
